name: Coins
description: The realm's currency. Even the dying world still runs on coin.

name: Bones
description: Something used to live in these.

name: Skull
description: It's looking at you. Don't make it weird.

name: Copper Ore
description: Unassuming. Unbothered. Already in a union.

name: Tin Ore
description: Copper's quiet neighbour.

name: Iron Ore
description: Heavier than its problems.

name: Coal
description: Compressed time and pressure, much like you.

name: Mithril Ore
description: Glows faintly. Refuses to explain why.

name: Logs
description: They were a tree. They're handling the change poorly.

name: Oak Logs
description: Denser. Grumpier. Still logs.

name: Willow Logs
description: Weep for them, or with them.

name: Raw Shrimp
description: Furious about being caught. Too small to do anything about it.

name: Raw Trout
description: Put up a fight. Lost.

name: Raw Lobster
description: Technically still defending itself.

name: Cooked Shrimp
description: Heals 3 HP. Still furious, but compliant.

name: Gritty Shrimps
description: Cooked over a tin-ore fire, which turned out to be exactly as advisable as it sounds.

name: Cooked Trout
description: Heals 10 HP.

name: Cooked Lobster
description: Heals 25 HP. The lobster has given up.

name: Small Mystic Gem (1hr)
description: Peer deeply into the mystical gem to teleport forward in time 1 hour with your current activity.

name: Medium Mystic Gem (4hr)
description: Four hours of your current activity, gone in the time it takes to blink.

name: Large Mystic Gem (12hr)
description: Half a day passes inside the stone. You do not age. Your ore does not mine itself any slower.

name: Massive Mystic Gem (24hr)
description: A full day, surrendered willingly. Check your materials before you look into it.

name: Gigantic Mystic Gem (72hr)
description: Three days. The gem is warm and slightly heavier than it should be. Bring supplies.

name: Shifting Sigil
description: Break the sigil to become something else entirely. Your levels, skills and belongings come with you; your talents are refunded and the tree emptied.

name: Bronze Bar
description: Copper + tin, melted together in their shared grief.

name: Iron Bar
description: Forged. Dense. Dependable.

name: Chaos Rune
description: Vibrates anxiously even when nothing is happening.

name: Death Rune
description: Extremely calm about everything. Suspicious.

name: Magic Staff
description: Still charged with something. Doesn't say what.

name: Iron Sword
description: Reliable. Won't start conversations.

name: Troll Hide
description: Tough. Smells of bridge and regret.

name: Gold Ore
description: Shiny. The trolls hoard it but never explain why.

name: Dragon Bones
description: Worth an incredible amount. Also weigh an incredible amount.

name: Dragon Scales
description: Iridescent. The dragon didn't want to give them up.

name: Faint Residue
description: A trace of something that used to matter. You can feel it resisting.

name: Iron Helm
description: Dented in a way that suggests it did its job at least once.

name: Traveller's Cape
description: Weathered, patched, and quietly proud of both.

name: Bronze Platebody
description: Heavy enough that you notice, light enough that you forgive it.

name: Linen Shirt
description: Comfortable. Offers approximately no protection.

name: Leather Gloves
description: Worn soft at the fingertips.

name: Guild Tabard
description: The guild it belonged to no longer exists. The tabard has not been told.

name: Emberlight
description: A slow drift of warm sparks that follows you everywhere.

name: Ring of the Glutton
description: Hungry on your behalf.

effects.equipText: Equip: has a chance to double how many items are produced at a campfire.

name: Stormcaller's Band
description: Faintly warm. Occasionally opinionated.

effects.equipText: Equip: you have a chance to hurl a ball of lightning when you use an ability.

name: Miner's Charm
description: Someone rubbed the engraving away entirely. It still works.

effects.equipText: Equip: has a chance to grant bonus Mining experience when you gather.

name: Pendant of Vigor
description: Beats very faintly, slightly out of time with you.

name: Keen Whetstone
description: Never wears down. Never explains itself.

name: Quickstep Charm
description: You keep arriving slightly before you meant to.

name: Campfire Sprite
description: It watches you cook and offers no advice.

effects.equipText: Equip: has a chance to double anything you craft.
